pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometries with rounded vertices and soft edge gradients. Relative spatial area of patches is larger on the upper flank, becoming more fragmented and smaller towards the lower abdomen.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of light-colored pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate. Pixel thickness is consistent across the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane creates a 1D geometric contour with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette. The texture appears as a uniform, short bristled line against the background.
